blazers.pulse: Portland won the battle of unbeatens in LA, 136-129, and is 3-0. Avdija and Morant had 23 each and Lillard iced it with a 3 in the final minute, even as Luka dropped 41. Scoot played after being questionable but had a rough night (2 points, 5 turnovers in 17 minutes).
storylines: Lillard's 3 with 43 seconds left sealed it
Avdija: 23 points and 9 assists; Morant also had 23
Henderson played through ankle soreness but struggled off the bench
Next: Memphis at home Thursday 7 pm, then at Utah Saturday

timbers.pulse: The Charlotte comeback kept the season alive, and Diego Chara has confirmed he'll retire after the 2027 sprint season. Tonight's trip to St. Louis is a must-win with three games left, and the odds aren't kind: St. Louis sits third in the West and Opta gives Portland about a 25% chance.
storylines: At St. Louis tonight (Wednesday), three regular-season games left
Still chasing the last West playoff spot after the 3-2 win over Charlotte
Diego Chara confirms retirement after the 2027 sprint season
Road form is the worry: two wins in their last 23 away matches

f1.pulse: Mexico City this Sunday (Nov 1) could crown Antonelli as F1's youngest-ever champion. Ninth place is enough, and Russell or Hamilton has to win just to keep it alive. Russell's form is the other talking point after a penalty dropped him to eighth in Austin and he said he lacked pace.
storylines: Antonelli clinches in Mexico with a ninth-place finish or better
Russell or Hamilton must win to push it to the next race
He'd be the youngest champion in F1 history
Four-way scrap for second behind him, with Verstappen and Leclerc close
Russell eighth in Austin after a five-second penalty
